smell: `safeMode: S.OptionFromOptionalKey(S.Boolean)` is consumed as `O.getOrElse(() => false)` at adapters/jsonld-document.ts:596-599; false is a constructor/decode default, not meaningful optional data.
proposedTarget: Use a boolean key default (`safeMode: SchemaUtils.BoolKeyDefaultFalse` or `S.Boolean.pipe(S.optionalKey, SchemaUtils.withKeyDefaults(false))`) so `normalizeJsonLdDocument` reads `request.safeMode` directly. In-repo bool default exemplar: packages/foundation/modeling/md/src/Md.model.ts:1101.

exception.reason: Changing safeMode from Option<boolean> to a defaulted boolean changes the encoded output for an omitted key from absent to safeMode:false and changes the public Type. That fails the §5.3 byte-identical wire-shape requirement without a dedicated public-form migration.
exception.boundary: encoded wire parity and public Type
